an4.95:1.3: N' ev' attahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya,
an4.95:2.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave chavālātaṃ ubhato padittaṃ majjhe gūthagataṃ n' eva gāme kaṭṭhaṭṭhaṃ pharati na araññe,
an4.95:2.2: tathūpamāhaṃ bhikkhave imaṃ puggalaṃ vadāmi yvāyaṃ puggalo n' ev' attahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya. 3.
an4.95:3.1: Tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ puggalo parahitāya paṭipanno no attahitāya ayaṃ imesaṃ dvinnaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
an4.95:3.2: Tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ puggalo attahitāya paṭipanno no parahitāya ayaṃ imesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ puggalānaṃ abhikkantataro ca paṇītataro ca.
an4.95:3.3: Tatra bhikkhave yvāyaṃ puggalo attahitāya ca paṭipanno parahitāya ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca. 4.
an4.95:4.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave gavā khīraṃ, khīramhā dadhi, dadhimhā navanītaṃ, navanītamhā sappi, sappimhā sappimaṇḍo tattha aggam akkhāyati, evam
an4.95:4.2: eva kho bhikkhave yvāyaṃ puggalo attahitāya ca paṭipanno parahitāya ca ayaṃ imesaṃ catunnaṃ puggalānaṃ aggo ca seṭṭho ca mokkho ca uttamo ca pavaro ca.
an4.95:4.3: Ime kho bhikkhave cattāro puggalā santo saṃvijjamānā lokasmin ti. 96. 1.
